info.title: Yamba — Trip Service API
info.description: Contrats générés depuis @packages/api-contracts (Zod v4, source de vérité unique — D3). Les clients consomment l'API via le gateway (:8080, préfixe /api) ; ce service écoute en direct sur :6002. Authentification : cookie access_token OU header Authorization: Bearer (le cookie est prioritaire).

get.description: Recherche publique paginée (cursor-based). Hard filters non-négociables : status=PUBLISHED et départ futur. Les trips malformés sont exclus silencieusement du mapping. ⚠️ Enveloppe SANS champ success (fidèle au réel).

BookingViewerRole.description: Role of the authenticated viewer for a deal (drives the DTO shape)

PricingModel.description: Pricing engine at booking creation time. PER_CATEGORY = current flat price per category; PER_KG = D13 target (price/kg x S/M/L size class). Snapshots are never migrated.

BookingTransitionAction.description: Actions of the booking state machine (canPerform/getAllowedActions). Returned in allowedActions to drive frontend CTAs — the frontend reflects, never decides.

TrackingStep.description: Optional tracking milestones inside PICKED_UP, strictly sequential

PayoutStatus.description: Carrier payout state (B4/D49). PENDING = deal COMPLETED, transfer not yet executed · SENT = transfer executed (payoutSentAt) · FAILED = transfer refused (retried by the payout cron) · FROZEN = dispute open (INV-5). null before COMPLETED / DISPUTED.

DisputeDesiredOutcome.description: What the shipper asks for (optional, informs mediation)

payoutStatus.description: SENT if the transfer succeeded inline, FAILED if the provider refused (retried by the cron — A67)

ConfirmDealResponse.description: Early confirmation done — payout released (INV-3: final)

pledgeAccepted.description: Honour pledge — must be true (anti-abuse, spec §3.6)

photoUrls.description: ImageKit URLs (direct signed upload — D42), optional but recommended

DisputeDealRequest.description: Open a dispute (shipper, DELIVERED, before payoutDueAt)

DisputeDealResponse.description: Dispute opened — payout frozen, ticket issued (INV-4/INV-5)

ShipperDisputeView.description: The dispute file as filed by the shipper (never served to the carrier)

departureAt.description: UTC — local rendering uses the two IANA timezones (D24)

BookingTripSnapshot.description: Trip facts frozen at booking creation — the deal stays readable even if the trip changes

categoryFamily.description: D14 risk-family mapping, frozen at creation

BookingRecipientSnapshot.description: Recipient contact — visible to both roles (the carrier needs it to deliver)

photoUrls.description: Carrier pickup photos (ImageKit URLs — D42, 1..5, server-timestamped)

checklist.description: The 5 inspection items ticked at pickup (CNF-04 attestation, frozen — B3). Empty on pre-B3 records.

ShipperPricing.description: Full pricing snapshot — shipper view only (all amounts in integer cents, A2)

transportCents.description: Carrier net earnings for this deal (COM-03)

CarrierPricing.description: Earnings-only pricing view — commission and shipper total are never exposed to the carrier

publicSlug.description: Public profile slug (/u/[slug]) — null for accounts without one (A45)

BookingCounterpart.description: Minimal profile of the other party (explicit join — Booking has no Prisma relations)

refundCents.description: Amount returned to the shipper if they cancel NOW (full total while PENDING; ANN-01 scale once ACCEPTED)

retentionCents.description: totalShipperCents - refundCents (0 while full refund applies)

retentionPct.description: Retention percentage applied after the full-refund deadline (server parameter §13)

fullRefundUntil.description: departureAt - 48h — cancelling before this instant refunds 100% (ANN-01/D39)

CancellationPreview.description: Server-computed ANN-01 preview shown before the shipper confirms a cancellation. Informative snapshot at read time — the refund is recomputed at the actual cancel.

pickupRefusalReason.description: Set when the carrier refused the parcel at pickup (PickupRefusalReason — B3/A40)

payoutStatus.description: Carrier payout state (B4/A68) — both roles read it; the transfer id is served to nobody

deliveryPhotoUrls.description: Optional handover photos taken by the carrier at delivery (B4-PR3/A76) — served to both parties

deliveryCode.description: 6-digit delivery code, revealed to the shipper ONLY while the parcel is in transit (PICKED_UP) and only on GET /deals/:id (never in lists — D43, AES-256-GCM at rest). null otherwise. Never present in any carrier payload.

codeRegenerationsLeft.description: MAX_CODE_REGENERATIONS (5) minus regenerations used — server is the only judge

cancellationPreview.description: Non-null exactly when 'cancel' is in allowedActions (PENDING or ACCEPTED)

dispute.description: The dispute file (status DISPUTED) — shipper only (A68); absent otherwise

disputeOpensAt.description: PICKED_UP only: when the 'not delivered' dispute becomes possible (trip departure + 48h — B4/D51). Served, never computed by the front (A72). null otherwise.

ShipperBookingView.description: Deal as seen by the shipper ('Mes envois')

pickupRefusalReason.description: Set when the carrier refused the parcel at pickup (PickupRefusalReason — B3/A40)

payoutStatus.description: Carrier payout state (B4/A68) — both roles read it; the transfer id is served to nobody

deliveryPhotoUrls.description: Optional handover photos taken by the carrier at delivery (B4-PR3/A76) — served to both parties

deliveryAttemptsLeft.description: MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS (3) minus attempts used — the code itself is NEVER exposed here

deliveryLockedUntil.description: Anti brute-force lock (15 min after 3 failed attempts, server-side)

disputeCategory.description: Why the shipper disputed (status DISPUTED) — the carrier sees the category, never the file (A68)

payoutAmountCents.description: Amount paid out to the carrier: the net at COMPLETED, the ANN-01 compensation at late CANCELLED (D50/A82)

retentionDisposition.description: Late cancellation only: the retention went to the carrier (compensation) or is held for mediation (cancelled after departure, A81)

payoutBlocker.description: Coarse cause when payoutStatus = FAILED (A75): ACCOUNT_NOT_READY → finish the Stripe onboarding (CTA) · RETRYING → provider-side error, retried automatically, nothing to do. Never the raw provider message. null otherwise.

CarrierBookingView.description: Deal as seen by the carrier — no delivery code, no code hash, no regeneration counter, no shipper total

tripId.description: Trip whose deals are requested — must belong to the caller

deal.description: ShipperBookingView when viewerRole=SHIPPER, CarrierBookingView when viewerRole=CARRIER

BookingEventType.description: All booking domain event keys (outbox → Kafka topics)

BookingEventCorridor.description: Frozen corridor facts for per-destination analytics

BookingEventBasePayload.description: Facts carried by EVERY booking event — rich by design so replayed history feeds future consumers

expiresAt.description: 24h acceptance deadline — carrier notification carries it

BookingRequestedEvent.description: New deal request → notify carrier (push + email, deadline)

reason.description: One of 5 optional decline reasons — refusal analytics

BookingDeclinedEvent.description: Carrier declined → full refund + notify shipper

BookingExpiredEvent.description: 24h elapsed without answer (cron) → full refund + notify shipper

wasAccepted.description: true = post-acceptance cancellation → carrier is notified too

BookingRefundIssuedEvent.description: Stripe refund succeeded (B2) → shipper confirmation email

BookingPickedUpEvent.description: Pickup confirmed, delivery code generated → notify shipper with an in-app CTA. The code itself NEVER travels in events or emails.

BookingPickupRefusedEvent.description: Refused at pickup → cancellation + refund + notify shipper

BookingTrackingEventEvent.description: Optional milestone → shipper push only (no email, anti-spam)

BookingCodeRegeneratedEvent.description: Code regenerated → shipper security email (code not included)

payoutDueAt.description: D+4 — end of the shipper verification window

BookingDeliveredEvent.description: Valid code entered → shipper '3 days to confirm or report' + carrier payout-scheduled notice

completedBy.description: SHIPPER = early confirmation, SYSTEM = D+4 auto

BookingCompletedEvent.description: Deal completed → payout release + mutual rating invitations

reason.description: Why the carrier is paid (A82). Absent on pre-D50 events = DELIVERY.

disputeCategory.description: Why the shipper disputed — the carrier learns the category, never the file (A68). Absent on pre-B4 events.

BookingDisputedEvent.description: Dispute filed → payout frozen, shipper acknowledgment (≤48 business hours) + carrier statement request

payoutDueAt.description: End of the verification window (D+4) — the reminder fires at D+3

BookingVerificationReminderEvent.description: D+3 reminder to the shipper: last day to confirm or dispute (B4/A70)

reminderNumber.description: D+5 then D+7, then stop (no spam)

targetRole.description: The party who has not rated yet

revealedReason.description: Double-blind lift: both rated, or 14 days

BookingRatingRevealedEvent.description: Double-blind reviews revealed → in-app notification to both

BookingDomainEvent.description: Any booking domain event — the parsing contract for every consumer (notifications, analytics, replay)

ParcelProduct.description: PRC-04 — parcel priced per kg, or a whole bag at a flat rate

quote.description: Server-side quote — what will be frozen (D17/D34)

BookingPlaceInput.description: Chosen among the trip's pickup/delivery points

weightKg.description: Declared weight (kg) — required for PARCEL; ignored for bags

description.description: Min 5 — same floor as the wizard (spec: recommended, low friction)

email.description: Optional — recipient notifications only when provided

DeclineReason.description: The 5 optional decline reasons offered to the carrier (spec É2)

charterAccepted.description: Carrier charter (verification, forbidden items, punctuality) — must be true (RGP-03)

refundAmountCents.description: Amount returned to the shipper (cents). Full total on PENDING closures (authorization released), ANN-01 amount on post-acceptance cancellation, null when nothing is returned (accept).

PickupChecklistItem.description: One of the 5 mandatory inspection items (spec É4a, CNF-04)

checklist.description: Must contain ALL 5 items — the server refuses a partial inspection (CNF-04)

photoUrls.description: 1 to 5 photo URLs already uploaded to ImageKit by the browser (D42)

PickupRefusalReason.description: The 5 optional refusal reasons offered to the carrier at pickup (spec É4a)

deliveryCode.description: The NEW code — the only write-path surface where it appears (shipper only). The previous code is invalid.

code.description: Code given by the recipient — compared with bcrypt server-side

photoUrls.description: OPTIONAL handover photos (ImageKit, direct signed upload — D42/A76): the carrier's insurance on the parcel state

payoutDueAt.description: deliveredAt + 4 days — end of the shipper verification window (B4 payout)

NotificationView.description: In-app notification (whitelist DTO — A13): userId/eventId never exposed

MyNotificationsResponse.description: GET /me/notifications — latest first, unread count included

FavoriteTripsResponse.description: Mes favoris — du plus récent au plus ancien, trajets passés inclus
